His bowl and his old red ball were still in the corner of the kitchen. I sat down on the floor and held his ball for a long time. Outside, the sky was gray, and rain fell steadily. I missed him so much.
solution: 글쓴이는 지난주에 죽은 반려견 Max를 그리워하고 있다. 매일 아침 문 앞에서 기다리던 반려견이 더 이상 보이지 않고, 부엌에는 밥그릇과 오래된 공만 남아 있다. 글쓴이가 공을 오랫동안 들고 있는 모습은 상실감과 그리움을 보여 준다. 회색 하늘과 계속 내리는 비도 우울한 분위기를 강화한다. ①은 조용한 장면이라는 점과 연결되지만 평화롭기보다는 슬프다. ②는 외로움을 일부 반영하지만 앞으로의 상황에 대한 희망은 드러나지 않는다. ④는 반려견과의 추억을 떠올린다는 점에서 따뜻함을 연상할 수 있지만 감사함이 중심은 아니다. ⑤는 추억을 되돌아보는 모습과 연결되지만 글 전체의 지배적인 정서는 깊은 슬픔이다. 따라서 ③이 정답이다.

body:
다음 우리말 뜻과 첫 글자를 참고하여 영어 단어를 완성하시오.

(문제 등을) 해결하다, 풀다

s _ _ _ _
solution:
'(문제 등을) 해결하다, 풀다'라는 뜻의 동사는 solve이다. 첫 글자 s 다음에 o, l, v, e를 차례로 쓰면 된다.

solve = 해결하다, 풀다

예문: I can solve this problem. (나는 이 문제를 풀 수 있다.)

body: 다음 중 밑줄 친 낱말의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?
solution: 뜨거운 햇볕 아래 아이스크림을 오래 두면 얼지 않고 녹는다. 따라서 freeze(얼다)는 melt(녹다)로 바꾸어야 한다.
choices: ① Please <u>check</u> your answers before you give your paper to the teacher.
② We walked around the island to <u>search</u> for the missing bag.
③ Ice cream will <u>freeze</u> if you leave it in the hot sun for a long time.
④ I couldn't read the words on the board <u>clearly</u> without my glasses.
⑤ Playing soccer together can <u>build</u> team spirit.

body: 다음 중 밑줄 친 낱말의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?
solution: 모든 답을 두 번씩 확인해 맞는지 살핀 것은 꼼꼼하게(주의 깊게) 과제를 했다는 뜻이다. 그런 행동이 보여 주는 것은 careful(주의 깊은)이므로, careless(부주의한)를 careful로 바꾸어야 한다.
choices: ① I couldn't solve the math problem, but my friend's <u>advice</u> helped me find the answer.
② My sister went back to school for her bag and <u>returned</u> home an hour later.
③ The students discussed their mistakes to <u>avoid</u> making the same ones again.
④ I couldn't see the board from the back, so I moved <u>closer</u> to it.
⑤ She checked every answer twice, which showed how <u>careless</u> she was about her work.

body: 다음 중 밑줄 친 낱말의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?
solution: 속도를 늦춰 친구들보다 더 뒤처졌다면(fell farther behind) 서로의 거리는 늘어난다. 따라서 decreased(줄어들었다)는 increased(늘어났다)로 바꾸어야 한다.
choices: ① When I slowed down, I fell farther behind my friends, so the distance between us <u>decreased</u>.
② We had no idea where the treasure was, so we decided to <u>continue</u> our search.
③ I couldn't remember my password, but it <u>finally</u> came back to me after several tries.
④ The rain stopped and the sun began to <u>shine</u>, so we went outside to play soccer.
⑤ The math problem looked difficult, but I <u>managed</u> to solve it without help.

body: 다음 중 밑줄 친 낱말의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?
solution: 모두가 끝까지 서로 도왔다는 것은 강한 협동심(team spirit)을 보였다는 뜻이다. 따라서 lacked(부족했다)는 showed(보였다)로 바꾸어야 한다.
choices: ① The movie showed that people could find happiness after hard times. Its message was <u>hopeful</u>.
② We wished each other good health because we wanted everyone to stay <u>well</u>.
③ We didn't buy the first bag we saw. We looked around to <u>compare</u> it with other bags.
④ Everyone on the team helped one another until the very end, so they clearly <u>lacked</u> team spirit.
⑤ I checked my answer against the one at the back of the book. They were <u>different</u>, so I solved the problem again.

body: 다음 중 밑줄 친 낱말의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은? 각 선지의 앞뒤 내용을 함께 고려하시오.
solution: 네잎클로버 찾기를 즐기는 학생은 단 한 명뿐이므로 그것은 우리 반에서 흔한 취미가 아니다. 따라서 common(흔한)은 uncommon(흔하지 않은)으로 바꾸어야 한다.
choices: ① I thought I had forgotten my password, but I entered it correctly on my first try. I had <u>actually</u> remembered it.
② Soccer was the most popular hobby in our class, while only one student enjoyed searching for four-leaf clovers. In our class, searching for four-leaf clovers was a <u>common</u> hobby.
③ My first answer was wrong, but checking it helped me understand the problem. The mistake turned out to be <u>useful</u>.
④ We hadn't found the treasure when it became dark. We stopped searching, although our task was still <u>unfinished</u>.
⑤ My sister usually gets home before me. Today, however, she was still at school when I arrived home, so I got home <u>earlier</u> than she did.

body: 다음 중 밑줄 친 낱말의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은? 각 선지의 앞뒤 내용을 함께 고려하시오.
solution: 더 꼼꼼하게 확인했다는 행동과 실제 실수의 개수 변화를 구별해야 한다. 실수가 두 개에서 여섯 개로 늘었으므로 decreased(줄어들었다)는 increased(늘어났다)로 바꾸어야 한다.
choices: ① I checked the answer at the back of the book only after solving the problem myself. The answer helped me <u>confirm</u> that my solution was correct.
② Our team lost the game, but we helped one another until the end. The result was disappointing, yet our team spirit remained <u>strong</u>.
③ I ran faster than before, but my friends were still running faster than me. My greater speed was <u>insufficient</u> to catch up with them.
④ The movie ended sadly, but its message made me believe that life could get better. Despite the ending, I felt <u>hopeful</u>.
⑤ I checked my answers more carefully on the second test. I made two mistakes on the first test and six on the second, so the number of mistakes <u>decreased</u>.

body: 다음 중 밑줄 친 낱말의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은? 각 선지의 앞뒤 내용을 함께 고려하시오.
solution: 누나(언니)는 먼저 학교를 나섰지만 가게에 들렀고, 나는 곧장 집으로 왔으므로 내가 먼저 도착한다. 따라서 later(더 늦게)는 earlier(더 일찍)로 바꾸어야 한다.
choices: ① We searched the whole island without finding the treasure. This did not <u>prove</u> that there was no treasure; we might have missed it.
② I remembered the correct password but typed one letter incorrectly. The problem was my typing, not my <u>memory</u>.
③ My sister left school before I did, but she stopped to look around some shops on the way. I went straight home, so I arrived home <u>later</u> than she did.
④ I got the right answer by chance and couldn't explain it. A correct answer did not necessarily show <u>understanding</u>.
⑤ All the players practiced their skills alone, but they rarely practiced together. Their individual skills did not <u>guarantee</u> good teamwork.
